svg.aria-label: M predicts the two couplings the model rests on
svg.text: M predicts the two couplings the model rests on
Cycling ventricular cardiomyocytes only (n=89), P0 and P7 pooled, so stage alone cannot explain the trend.
Cytokinesis competence falls with maturation and the exit enforcer rises. Both are therefore measured functions of M, not fitted
parameters — which removes the model's largest degree of freedom.
